text:
maria: Quick async check — planning to enable ff.quant.profile=int8 for model `redwood-7b:v2` in a canary. Target audience: 5% web traffic + internal dev header. Need to confirm rollback triggers, monitoring hooks, and any SLO impacts before flipping. cc @jon @lee

jon: OK. Metric windows? I suggest p95 latency <= baseline * 1.15 and error rate delta < 0.1%. For quality, failure rate on eval prompt set shouldn't increase > 1%. If either threshold breached, auto-rollback.

lee: Also flag: ff.precision.kv_compat=true? int8 can change KV cache layout on some runtimes. If kv_compat=false we need to force cold caches for canary only.

maria: Good catch. Plan is to set kv_compat=true for the canary so it reads legacy cache. If we see cache miss spike > 20% we abort.

sarah: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/infer/pull/3310 — adds canary rule, flag wiring, and a small opt-in on the routing layer. Tests included. Please review if you haven't. :eyes:

priyam: Ran staging smoke: on synthetic load int8 reduced tokens/sec by ~3% but decreased GPU mem by ~25%. Latency p95 increased ~2%. Not alarming but we should watch tail latency under multi-tenant bursts. Logs snippet from smoke:```
[2026-05-01T14:02:03Z] model=redwood-7b:v2 profile=int8 p95=123ms p50=32ms errors=0
[2026-05-01T14:02:12Z] model=redwood-7b:v2 profile=fp16 p95=121ms p50=31ms errors=0
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for ff.quant.profile=int8 on model redwood-7b:v2. Audience=5% (web=5%, internal=100%). Canary id=canary-20260501-42. Monitoring hooks: infra-metrics, eval-harness, rerank-regressions.

jon: Added alert rules: infra/p95 > baseline*1.12 sustained 3m, eval/quality_drop > 0.8% across validation_bucket_1. Also added an incident-on-call ping to eng-oncall if both triggers fire.

lee: Quick checklist before we increase audience:
- confirm smoke runs green across 3 regions
- ensure fallback model variants available (fp16 fallback tagged)
- disable quant cache sharing across canary
- QA signoff on top-50 prompts

maria: Filling in: smoke ok in us-west/us-east, eu-west pending. FP16 fallback is available as `redwood-7b:v2@fp16`. Cache sharing toggled off in routing config. QA will run top-50 tonight (ETA 22:00 PT).

priyam: One small note — promo routes that use long contexts (>=8k) see slightly higher p95 variance with int8. Suggest excluding long-context users from the canary for first 24h: add rule `context_len < 4096` to canary filter.

maria: Agreed. I've updated canary rule via console to include `context_len < 4096`. Will monitor for 12h then consider 20% audience if stable.

sarah: Thanks — I'll merge the PR after a couple of last reviews. If anyone sees >0.8% quality regression, post eval diffs here and I'll stop the roll. :thumbsup:

maria: Closing loop — ops alert and oncall added, PR pending merge, canary filters tightened. Will post a summary after 12h with metrics. Thanks everyone for quick checks!
